module_title: Mysteries, High Altitudes, and the Niagara of India
introduction: At the advanced level, examiners focus on high Himalayan lakes, mysteries like the Skeleton Lake, and the South/East Indian waterfalls that are directly tied to river systems.

core_concepts.title: Roopkund Lake
core_concepts.description:
State: **Uttarakhand** (Himalayas).
Key Feature: Widely known as the **'Skeleton Lake'** or 'Mystery Lake'. When the ice melts, hundreds of ancient human skeletons become visible at the edge and bottom of the lake.

core_concepts.title: High Altitude Lakes
core_concepts.description:
1. **Cholamu Lake (Tso Lhamo):** **Sikkim**. It is one of the **highest lakes** in the world (approx. 5,330 meters). The Teesta River originates from here.
2. **Pangong Tso:** **Ladakh**. An endorheic (landlocked) saltwater lake. A portion of it lies in India, and the larger portion in Tibet (China). It freezes completely during winter.

core_concepts.title: The Niagara of India
core_concepts.description:
**Chitrakote Falls:** **Chhattisgarh** (Bastar district). 
River: **Indravati River** (A tributary of the Godavari). 
Key Feature: Because of its impressive width and horseshoe shape during the monsoons, it is famously called the 'Niagara Falls of India'.

core_concepts.title: Crucial Falls of the South and East
core_concepts.description:
1. **Shivasamudram Falls:** **Karnataka** (**Kaveri River**). India's first hydroelectric power station was set up here in 1902.
2. **Hundru Falls:** **Jharkhand** (Ranchi). It is located on the **Subarnarekha River**.

important_entities.name: Hussain Sagar Lake
important_entities.significance: An artificial lake in Telangana (Hyderabad) that separates Hyderabad from its twin city Secunderabad. A massive monolithic statue of Lord Buddha stands in the middle of it.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Exam Trap: Seeing the name 'Shiva', students often associate it with North Indian rivers or the Narmada. Remember, the 'Shivasamudram' waterfall is strictly on the **Kaveri River** in South India.

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Chitrakote (Chitra means Picture) is the Niagara of India.

exam_strategy_tips: A highly repeated 'Match the Following' in NDA/CDS and SSC CGL: 'Hundru - Subarnarekha River', 'Dhuandhar - Narmada River', 'Chitrakote - Indravati River'.
